capability_notes.VC: No throat diameter, no scaled Pc(t), time-varying throat from slag.
capability_notes.VD: Measured c* is tabulated, but c* efficiency rests on an unnamed theoretical code; delivered c* may be displayed, not compared as 'CEA error'.

notes: Downgraded by the R1 audit from a 'Gold candidate': a reference and validation candidate for low-rate motor burning rate and delivered c* only. It is not a Gold case, not source-complete for NASA CEA, and not a complete internal-ballistics case: no throat diameter (slag deposition changed the throat during firing; the final area was measured after each test) and Pc(t) only as an unscaled 'typical' figure (Figure 1). Motor 72-18-1 sized the throat and is excluded from the source's averages; 72-18-3 ignited poorly. Motor firing results (Table II, report p.9) and strand rates (Figure 3, p.8, plotted only) are cited, not carried: this record ships the formulation; firing data belong to later evidence work. Ingredient labels follow the R1 transcription of the source table; they are not a verbatim copy of its row headings.
